review.finding: _path_without_real_gh removed every PATH folder holding a gh, which drops /usr/bin on Linux CI and breaks git and sh lookups.
review.suggestion: Never remove folders; put the shim folder first and keep git reachable (test it). FIXED in f457cd7.

review.finding: The recorder ran git under the test process environment: inherited GIT_DIR and user git config could change the trace.
review.suggestion: Hermetic git environment (no GIT_*, empty global config, no system config, quotePath off); hostile-config test. FIXED in f457cd7.

review.finding: Inline release notes given with the short flag -n were not masked.
review.suggestion: Treat -n like --notes and test it. FIXED in f457cd7.

review.finding: Short SHAs were replaced before path labels, so a hex run inside a path could survive.
review.suggestion: Normalize paths first, then short SHAs. FIXED in f457cd7.

review.finding: diff-tree output was quoted for non-ASCII paths, dropping their blobs.
review.suggestion: core.quotePath=false plus a non-ASCII path test. FIXED in f457cd7.

review.finding: Fidelity limits (release create without --verify-tag, missing notes file exit code) were undocumented.
review.suggestion: Document in the docstring. FIXED in f457cd7.

review.finding: Function-level imports, extra blank line and a vacuous assertion in the bare-gh test.
review.suggestion: Module imports; assert the shim folder. FIXED in f457cd7.
